good.subject: ci: add git-commit-analyzer to the commit-check stage of the gitlab-ci.yml to check correctness of the commits
good.description:
Currently to analyze commits you need to manually
Examine each of them. That is not convenient and requires
lots of time. git-commit-analyzer tries to automate it.
This commit adds git commit analyzer in the gitlab-ci.yml:
- new stage 'commit-check' is added
- the gca.yml is included

good.subject: ci: add new gca.yml (git-commit-analyzer) checker to check git commits in the GitLab CI
good.description:
Enable git-commit-analyzer to check commit messages:
- static analyzer is enabled after every push on merge reuqests
- llm analyzer needs manual action to start
